_comment: Cycle-charge stance demo (seed 12345): box-select the player's two cavalry regiments (right of the line, ~x 1027 and 1356, y 300), press J to arm the Cycle charge stance, then right-click the enemy Infantry regiment at (291,880). The horse charges in, lands its momentum hit, then peels back to a standoff and charges AGAIN -- the caracole loop -- instead of grinding in melee once the charge bonus is spent. The HUD flashes 'Cycle charge' when J is pressed and the order cursor turns violet.

overlap.reason: Charging cavalry peels back and compresses laterally during cycle-charge caracole maneuver before re-forming. uid 7 (team 1 archers) is downstream of team 1's own cavalry, which sits at the reference depth ratio (2.81) and now pivots its early formed turn at 0.6 pace: the two runs diverge from tick 19 and by tick 900 the archers are in a different engagement (measured on the same machine at the catalog cadence: main uid7 overlap worst 30.5 wu, branch 1.98 wu against the 2.25 floor; main uid6 overlap 0.15 wu and shape residual 59.4 wu, both cleared on the branch). The archers block itself is not deep by the metric (ratio 1.49, fraction 1.0), so its own pace and corridor band are unchanged. uid8 IS that team 1 cavalry itself (depth ratio 505.96/(40wu file pitch x 4.5) = 2.810913, exactly the reference case, frac 0.6): its own reduced pivot rate changes its whole AI chase trajectory against the player's cavalry (target_enemy_uid cycling 3->4->2 as it repeatedly re-faces), so it covers far less net distance over the clip than on main (main reaches x=256/y=501 by tick 1300, closing to melee and reaching FIGHTING at tick 1200; this branch only reaches x=842/y=576 by tick 1300, never engaging) -- the same divergence already responsible for uid7's exemption, now also visible as an overlap dip in uid8's own bodies at the clip's final sample (main nnd_min 14.19wu at tick 1300 vs this branch's 4.49wu against the 5.0wu floor). Downstream chase-trajectory chaos from the intended pivot-rate derate, not a standing formation defect; measured on both worktrees at the catalog cadence.

shape_residual.reason: Charging cavalry block deforms during cycle-charge impact, peel-back, and subsequent regrouping. Uid5 (team 1's spearmen by scenario order: spearmen, infantry, archers, cavalry, cavalry; the scripted charge itself targets uid6, the infantry at x 291, and uid5 reads FIGHTING and engaged from about tick 1020 in the melee that follows) is additionally policed post-melee by SoldierBodies._separate_same_unit's new arm-on-leaving-FIGHTING trigger (Unit._arm_standoff_on_leaving_fight_or_rout): it leaves FIGHTING around tick 1020-1080 with soldiers collapsed to near-zero separation (pre-fix nnd_min as low as 0.07wu at tick 1260), and the standoff pass spends the settle window separating them (post-fix nnd_min 4.2-4.7wu, clean of the overlap defect the pre-fix tree fails instead). The separation is gradual (capped at STANDOFF_MAX_SPEED), so the shape-fit residual stays elevated 1-2 samples longer than the pre-fix tree's single-sample spike (measured worst=21.9 at tick 1200, sustaining through tick 1260 vs the pre-fix tree's non-sustained worst=21.8 at the same tick) before it resumes decaying (19.8 by the clip's final tick).

path_crossing.reason: Charging cavalry paths cross during the cycle-charge breakthrough, disengagement wheel, and realignment.
